Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Butter Chicken Stuffed Potato Bread Ingredients DOUGH 500 g potatoes (450 g/1 lb peeled) 0.5 g dried parsley (1 tsp) 5 g salt (⅚ tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 1 egg (medium) 200 g all-purpose flour (1 3/4 cup) CHICKEN FILLING 25 g unsalted butter (2 tbsp) 550 g chicken thighs, diced (1¼ lb) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 1 g black pepper (⅓ tsp) ½ chicken boullion cube, or ½ tsp bouillon powder 30 g tomato paste, (2 tbsps) 100 ml heavy cream, (1/2 cup) 75 g grated cheese, (2/3 cup) 10 g kecap manis (sweet soy sauce), (1½ tsp) INSTRUCTIONS Cut the peeled potatoes into cubes. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the potatoes for 15-20 minutes, until fork-tender. Drain and let them steam dry for a few minutes. Add the dried parsley, salt and garlic powder. Mash until completely smooth. Mix in the egg, then add the flour and knead until a cohesive dough forms. It’s fine if it’s a little sticky, as long as it holds its shape. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken, cayenne, garam masala, cumin, garlic powder and black pepper, then crumble the bouillon cube over the top. Cook for 5-6 minutes, until the chicken is golden brown on all sides. Stir in the tomato paste and pour in the heavy cream. Simmer for 4-5 minutes, until the sauce is creamy and slightly thickened. Stir in the shredded cheese and the kecap manis or honey. Let the filling cool completely. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball. Lightly flour your work surface and hands. Press or roll each ball into a flat square. Lay a slice of cheese in the center of each square and top with about ⅓ cup (80 g) of the cooled filling. Fold the bottom and top edges inward, then fold the sides over to close it into a neat parcel. Place the buns seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Repeat until all the buns are shaped. Heat a skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with oil or butter. Fry the buns for 3-4 minutes per side, until deep golden brown. Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Creamy Chicken Tostones 😍 This recipe is a 10/10, and I’m already thinking about making it again next week. 😋 Ingredients:  * 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces * ½ teaspoon each salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano * Oil, for cooking the chicken and frying the plantains * 2 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks * ⅓ red bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ green bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ white onion, sliced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tablespoon butter * 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for topping * 1 tablespoon tomato paste * 1/2  chicken bouillon * 1½ cups heavy cream, or adjust to your preferred amount of sauce * ⅓ cup Parmesan cheese (add more if you want to) Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano. 2. Heat a little oil in a pan over high heat. Add the chicken and sear until browned and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. Heat oil in a separate pan over medium-low heat. Fry the plantain chunks until tender but not too browned. Remove and flatten each piece with a tostonera or the bottom of a cup. 4. Raise the heat and fry the flattened plantains until crispy and golden. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with salt right away. 5. In a pan, heat a little oil and melt the butter. Add the peppers and onion and cook for about a minute. Add the garlic and cilantro and cook for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Stir in the tomato paste and chicken bouillon. One Pan Honey Garlic Chicken 🍯🧄 Prep Time: 10 mins | Cook Time: 15 mins | Servings: 4 INGREDIENTS Seasoned Chicken 1.5-2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces (NOTE: the video features chicken breasts, but this recipe will be the best with thighs) 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper 1/2 tsp kosher salt (to taste) 1-2 tbsp neutral oil (for pan-searing) Honey Garlic Ginger Glaze 1/3 cup honey 1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce 4-5 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated 2 tbsp water or chicken broth (optional) For Serving and Garnish Cooked white rice Toasted sesame seeds Sliced scallions (green onions) INSTRUCTIONS 1. Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and toss in a bowl with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Add cornstarch and toss again until evenly coated in a thin, powdery layer. 2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add chicken in a single layer (avoid overcrowding) and cook for 4-5 minutes per side (or 6-7 minutes total if cut into bite-sized pieces) until golden-brown on the outside and just underdone inside (about 155°F-160°F). 3. Drop heat to medium-low. Push chicken to the edges of the skillet and add minced garlic and grated ginger to the center, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in honey and soy sauce (plus water or broth if using). 4. Toss chicken continuously in the bubbling sauce for 2-3 minutes until the residual cornstarch thickens the sauce into a glossy glaze and chicken reaches at least 175°F internal. 5. Serve immediately over warm white rice, spooning extra pan glaze over the top. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced scallions. #recipe #cooking #asmr #foodtok
